item.description:

By

A health care worker administers a dose of Ervebo vaccine against the Ebola virus in Beni, North Kivu province, eastern Congo, on Oct. 16.
Sebastien Kitsa Musayi/AP
hide caption

Sebastien Kitsa Musayi/AP
LAGOS, Nigeria — Nigeria confirmed an Ebola case in its capital, Abuja, on Tuesday after a woman who arrived from Uganda tested positive for the virus, the Health Ministry said.
The woman began showing symptoms on Oct. 7 and was admitted to a private hospital in Abuja on Oct. 11, where she was later diagnosed with Ebola.
Global Health
The Ebola crisis is far outpacing the response, Congo's IRC director says
Health Minister Muhammad Pate said authorities had begun tracing 44 people identified as contacts of the patient. "We are doing everything possible to contain this case by tracing all the contacts the individual may have had," he said.
Uganda had previously reported Ebola cases but it later declared itself free of the virus.

item.title: Vanessa Kerry is the new WHO envoy for health resilience. What's on her to-do list?
item.description:
Global Health
Vanessa Kerry is the new WHO envoy for health resilience. What's on her to-do list?
October 20, 202612:27 PM ET
By
Diane Cole
Dr. Vanessa Kerry has been named the special envoy for health resilience at the World Health Organization.
Joel Saget/AFP via Getty Images
hide caption
toggle caption i
Joel Saget/AFP via Getty Images
Resilience is one of those buzzy buzzwords. But what does it mean, exactly? Bouncing back from tragedy? Conquering obstacles? Having the inner strength to follow a dream when the odds are against you?
For Dr. Vanessa Kerry, the definition is pretty straightforward. It boils down to being prepared. In the world of global health, she says, that means "strong systems, primary care and the ability to respond."
Those are the ideas that will guide her in her new job as special envoy for health resilience at the World Health Organization.

item.title: Rays will face Brewers in World Series to produce a first-time champion
item.description:
Sports
Rays will face Brewers in World Series to produce a first-time champion
October 20, 20262:28 AM ET
By
The Associated Press
Tampa Bay Rays third baseman Junior Caminero celebrates their win against the Cleveland Guardians in Game 6 of an American League Championship Series baseball game in St. Petersburg, Fla. Monday, Oct. 19, 2026.
David J. Phillip/AP
hide caption
toggle caption i
David J. Phillip/AP
ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. — Yandy Díaz's bat backed up his boast, and the Tampa Bay Rays are headed to the World Series again.
Díaz and Junior Caminero each hit a two-run homer, Freddy Peralta pitched 5 1/3 gritty innings and the Rays beat the Cleveland Guardians 7-3 in Game 6 of the American League Championship Series on Monday night to win their third pennant in 29 seasons as a major league franchise.
The Rays will face the NL champion Milwaukee Brewers in the first matchup in which both teams are seeking their first World Series title since 1980, when the Philadelphia Phillies beat the Kansas City Royals.
Game 1 is Friday night in Milwaukee.
"We got one more bite!" Rays manager Kevin Cash told his team as the clubhouse celebration started.
Díaz, who guaranteed a Game 6 victory through an interpreter on Sunday, made sure the Rays wouldn't let this one slip away. He gave them...

item.title: Alberta voters reject a move toward independence in referendum backing Canadian unity
item.description:
World
Alberta voters reject a move toward independence in referendum backing Canadian unity
Updated October 20, 20263:22 PM ET
Originally published October 20, 20262:02 AM ET
By
The Associated Press
Supporters wait for results at the pro-Canada watch party in Edmonton, Alberta, Monday.
James Maclennan/The Canadian Press via AP
hide caption
toggle caption i
James Maclennan/The Canadian Press via AP
EDMONTON, Alberta — Voters in oil-rich Alberta province overwhelmingly backed remaining in Canada, according to referendum results released Tuesday, delivering a boost to Prime Minister Mark Carney's push for national unity as U.S. President Donald Trump's trade war and annexation threats rally Canadians around their country.
The Americas
Alberta voters weigh future in Canada
With more than 1.8 million votes counted and results reported from 84% of voting areas and locations, 75% of voters supported remaining in Canada, while 25% backed beginning a process toward separation, according to unofficial results from Elections Alberta.
